title: He Was The Only Reader Of A Novel... Then It Became Real . . .

segments.say: This guy is the only person on Earth who knows how the *world ends*.
Jack was a boring office worker who read one web novel on the subway every day.
The novel had over *three thousand* chapters, and only one reader. Him.
For ten years, he never skipped a *single* chapter.
On the day of the final chapter, the author finally sent him a message.
He thanked Jack for reading, and promised him a special *gift*.
The gift said: starting at seven PM, this story will help you.
Jack looked at the clock. It was six fifty nine.
At exactly seven PM, the train shook, and something *smiled* in the dark.
Then a strange message appeared in front of every passenger.
The novel Jack read for ten years had just become *real*.
And he is the only one who knows how *everyone dies*.
